scope: Actual engines and UI source executed in Node VM with DOM stubs; synthetic data. No browser, Windows or clinical qualification claim.
checks: Initial preview leaves original fields and note untouched
Adoption updates facts and draft, requires fresh review
Append report keeps previous dates and numbers
An unrelated manually edited paragraph survives an update
A touched manually edited paragraph prevents adoption
A stale preview never overwrites later manual edits
Undo restores prior facts and note; does not clobber subsequent edits
Four templates switch using the same case
Unlabelled follow-ups require a destination, not a guessed fact
Analysis commands use local tools without changing the record
Chat sends a correction, previews, adopts and retains conversation
Switching modes retains values, note and conversation
Chat report analysis displays provenance, never auto-applies
New case clears conversation, proposals and undo state
History import validates bounds and preserves literal text
Medical uncertainty remains input, not a question command
Editing a syndrome updates the selection and requires confirmation
Save and reopen restore exact draft and conversation, reset review
Invalid imported history leaves current record untouched
